outcome: Association between BMI, physical activity, and acetabular dysplasia
cohort: 9-year-old children from the Generation R study, a prospective cohort study in the Netherlands
finding: Being overweight and engaging in light physical activity were negatively associated with the development of mild acetabular dysplasia at 9 years of age.
mod_finding: The study found no significant association between mode of delivery and acetabular dysplasia in children.
